context_exceeded.guidance: Choose a model with a larger context window, raise this model's window in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath) if the server allows more, or send a shorter message.
context_exceeded.title: The conversation is too long for {{name}}'s model.

anthropic_stream_incomplete.guidance: {{name}} ended the reply before it finished. Try sending your message again.
anthropic_stream_incomplete.title: The reply was interrupted.

attached_image_unavailable.guidance: Remove it, or attach it again, then send.
attached_image_unavailable.title: An attached image is no longer available.

chat_stream_interrupted.guidance: The connection ended before Animama confirmed completion. Check your connection before sending again.
chat_stream_interrupted.title: The reply was interrupted.

chatgpt_plan_not_eligible.guidance: Check your plan's usage in ChatGPT, or choose another model.
chatgpt_plan_not_eligible.title: Your ChatGPT plan doesn't include this.

chatgpt_plan_sign_in_required.guidance: The ChatGPT plan session ended. Sign in again in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath).
chatgpt_plan_sign_in_required.title: Sign in with ChatGPT again.

chatgpt_plan_unavailable.guidance: Try again in a moment, or choose another model.
chatgpt_plan_unavailable.title: ChatGPT plan usage is unavailable right now.

chatgpt_plan_unsupported_request.guidance: Choose another model for this chat.
chatgpt_plan_unsupported_request.guidanceDetail: OpenAI said: “{{detail}}” Choose another model for this chat.
chatgpt_plan_unsupported_request.title: The ChatGPT plan couldn't take this request.

chatgpt_plan_usage_limit.guidance: Send again after OpenAI resets your limit, or choose another model. Review your usage on OpenAI's page.
chatgpt_plan_usage_limit.title: You've reached your ChatGPT plan's usage limit.

chatgpt_plan_use_not_granted.guidance: Enable plan use in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath), or choose another model.
chatgpt_plan_use_not_granted.title: ChatGPT plan use is off.

connection_base_url_missing.guidance: Set its base URL in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath), then send your message again.
connection_base_url_missing.title: {{name}} has no server address.

connection_unavailable.guidance: Select another model, then send your message again.
connection_unavailable.title: The selected model's connection was removed.

gateway_request_rejected.guidance: Open Animama at its configured application address, or reopen the desktop app. Ask the installation owner to check access settings if this continues.
gateway_request_rejected.title: This installation refused the request.

missing_api_key.guidance: Ask the installation owner to add its key in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath) or API Keys, then send your message again.
missing_api_key.title: {{name}} has no API key configured.

model_does_not_accept_images.guidance: Choose a model that accepts images, or remove the images and send again.
model_does_not_accept_images.title: This model can't see images.

model_refused.title: The model declined to respond to this message.

openai_authentication_error.guidance: Ask the installation owner to check the key configured for {{name}} before trying again.
openai_authentication_error.title: {{name}} rejected the API key.

openai_bad_request.guidance: Check the selected model and its settings in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath) before trying again.
openai_bad_request.title: {{name}} rejected this request.

openai_connection_error.guidance: Check your internet connection and try again when you're ready.
openai_connection_error.guidanceLocal: Is {{localServer}} running? Start it, then try again.
openai_connection_error.guidanceLocalAt: Is {{localServer}} running at {{baseUrl}}? Start it, then try again.
openai_connection_error.title: Animama couldn't reach {{name}}.

openai_not_found.guidance: Check the model ID in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath) or select another model.
openai_not_found.title: {{name}} couldn't find the selected model.

openai_overloaded.guidance: Wait a little before sending your message again.
openai_overloaded.title: {{name}} is temporarily unavailable.

openai_permission_denied.guidance: Check the account's model access or select another available model.
openai_permission_denied.title: {{name}} denied access to this model.

openai_quota_exceeded.guidance: Check the account's billing and usage limits before trying again.
openai_quota_exceeded.title: {{name}}'s account has reached its usage limit.

openai_rate_limit.guidance: Wait a little before sending your message again.
openai_rate_limit.title: {{name}} is receiving too many requests.

openai_server_error.guidance: Wait a little before sending your message again.
openai_server_error.guidanceLocal: Check that {{localServer}} has the model loaded, then try again.
openai_server_error.title: {{name}} couldn't complete this request.

openai_timeout.guidance: Check your connection and try again when you're ready.
openai_timeout.guidanceLocal: The model may still be loading. Try again, or raise the connection's timeout in $t(chatFailure.settingsPath).
openai_timeout.title: {{name}} took too long to respond.

too_many_images.guidance: Remove some so it carries no more than four, then send again.
too_many_images.title: This message has too many images.

chatLimitReached.guidance: Continue one of your existing chats.
chatLimitReached.title: This account has reached its chat limit.
chatLimitReached.titleLimit: This account has reached its chat limit ({{limit, number}} chats).

messageTooLong.guidance: Shorten your message, then send it again.
messageTooLong.guidanceMaximum: Messages can be up to {{maximum, number}} characters.
messageTooLong.title: This message is too long.

quotaExceeded.title: You've reached this account's hosted usage limit.

quotaInputTokens.guidance: Start a new chat or shorten your message.
quotaInputTokens.title: This conversation is too long for one hosted turn.

trialComplete.guidance: Download Animama to keep chatting with your Animas.
trialComplete.title: Your Animama trial is complete.

network.guidance: Check your connection and whether the installation is running, then try again.
network.title: Animama couldn't connect to its service.

notice.notConfirmed: Completion wasn't confirmed. This notice and any partial reply are kept here until you leave this chat or reload.
notice.restoreDisabled: Available when no reply is active and the composer is empty.
notice.restoreHint: Restores the text for editing. Nothing is sent automatically.
notice.retryAfter_one: The provider recommends waiting at least {{count}} second before another attempt.
notice.retryAfter_other: The provider recommends waiting at least {{count}} seconds before another attempt.

service.guidance: Wait a little, then try again. If this continues, check or restart the installation's service.
service.title: Animama's service is unavailable.

unknown.guidance: Restore your message to try again. If this continues, share the error code with the installation owner.
unknown.title: The message couldn't be completed.

composer.waitingForFiles: Waiting for files to be ready

toasts.avatarSessionExpired: This Avatar session expired. Reload it, then send your message again.
toasts.filesNotReady: Attached files are not ready yet.
toasts.modelNotDirect: This model is not available for direct chat yet.
toasts.newChatModelFailed: Failed to start a new chat with that model.
toasts.restoreModelFailed: Failed to restore this chat's model.

transcript.emptyDescription: Start a chat to see messages here
